# CC0 Adventurers

<!-- Generated from the models by tools/clipinventory. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Regenerate from the repository root with `go run ./tools/clipinventory -out library/packs/cc0-adventurers/README.md library/packs/cc0-adventurers/mage.gltf library/packs/cc0-adventurers/knight.gltf`.

Both models are placeholder fixtures (one triangle skinned to one joint) released as CC0-1.0. They fix the twelve clip names a game can wire its animations to, so the KayKit Adventurers models (CC0) can replace them under the same names once skinned models draw in scenes (#1382).
